title: Medical Scientists, Except Epidemiologists
description: Conduct research dealing with the understanding of human diseases and the improvement of human health. Engage in clinical investigation, research and development, or other related activities.

tasks.text: Follow strict safety procedures when handling toxic materials to avoid contamination.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Conformance checking aided by AI, but on-site verification is human

dwas.name: Monitor operational procedures in technical environments to ensure conformance to standards.

tasks.text: Evaluate effects of drugs, gases, pesticides, parasites, and microorganisms at various levels.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Literature and data aided; lab work human

dwas.name: Research diseases or parasites.

tasks.text: Plan and direct studies to investigate human or animal disease, preventive methods, and treatments for disease.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Research planning needs domain expertise and feasibility

dwas.name: Plan biological research.
Direct medical science or healthcare programs.

tasks.text: Prepare and analyze organ, tissue, and cell samples to identify toxicity, bacteria, or microorganisms or to study cell structure.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Biological sample analysis needs wet-lab execution

dwas.name: Analyze biological samples.

tasks.text: Conduct research to develop methodologies, instrumentation, and procedures for medical application, analyzing data and presenting findings to the scientific audience and general public.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI researches and synthesizes; human judges relevance

dwas.name: Analyze health-related data.
Research topics in area of expertise.
Present research results to others.

tasks.text: Teach principles of medicine and medical and laboratory procedures to physicians, residents, students, and technicians.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Science instruction content AI-assisted; delivery human

dwas.name: Instruct college students in physical or life sciences.

tasks.text: Write and publish articles in scientific journals.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reports drafted; presentations need human delivery

dwas.name: Prepare scientific or technical reports or presentations.

tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft grant text; human owns strategy and budget

dwas.name: Write grant proposals.
Prepare proposals or grant applications to obtain project funding.

tasks.text: Standardize drug dosages, methods of immunization, and procedures for manufacture of drugs and medicinal compounds.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI drafts care standards; clinical authority decides

dwas.name: Establish standards for medical care.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Study animal and human health and physiological processes.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI researches and synthesizes; human judges relevance

dwas.name: Collect information about community health needs.
Check physical condition of people or animals.
Measure the physical or physiological attributes of patients.
Research topics in area of expertise.

tasks.text: Investigate cause, progress, life cycle, or mode of transmission of diseases or parasites.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Literature and data aided; lab work human

dwas.name: Research diseases or parasites.

tasks.text: Use equipment such as atomic absorption spectrometers, electron microscopes, flow cytometers, or chromatography systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on lab/field equipment operation with samples

dwas.name: Operate laboratory or field equipment.

tasks.text: Confer with health departments, industry personnel, physicians, and others to develop health safety standards and public health improvement programs.
tasks.rationale: text generation — AI drafts standards; committee consensus and authority human

dwas.name: Establish standards for products, processes, or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Consult with and advise physicians, educators, researchers, and others regarding medical applications of physics, biology, and chemistry.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Healthcare advice carries liability; human owns it
